summary: Phase 0 CareerPilot tested end-to-end via external URL. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (health, anon 401 envelope, register USER/CONSULTANT 201 + httpOnly Secure cookie, ADMIN register 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, duplicate 409, weak pw 400, login ok/401 'Invalid email or password', /me, dashboard stats+services+partial:false, /api/bookings 404 JSON, logout clears session, direct service calls on 4001/4002/4003 -> MISSING_INTERNAL_TOKEN, forged token -> INVALID_INTERNAL_TOKEN). Resume-template node tests 2/2 pass. Frontend: login validation + login-error alert, USER/CONSULTANT/ADMIN role redirects and role-specific sidebars, route protection (anon -> /login?next=..., next honored for /dashboard and /resumes, cross-role redirect to home, logged-in /login and / redirect to home), register USER and CONSULTANT via role toggle with redirect by role, duplicate email register-error, logout, all placeholder pages render page-title + empty state, profile details, mobile 390px sheet nav + logout, no horizontal overflow, no page errors.

issues: Empty email shows 'Enter a valid email' instead of a 'required' message (cosmetic)
Health pill collapses to just a green dot and no brand shown in top bar (acceptable, cosmetic)

critical_code_review_comments: lib/access.ts safeNext/canAccess compares raw `next` including query string; e.g. next=/dashboard?tab=x fails the prefix check and silently falls back to role home (minor UX).

Gateway PUBLIC_PATHS uses exact case-sensitive Set match while Express routing is case-insensitive/trailing-slash tolerant; this fails closed (safe) but /api/health/ or /api/auth/login/ would return 401 instead of working.
Gateway dashboard 'partial' is computed as ai.status !== booking.status — correct for 2 services, but will need rework when more services are aggregated.
